# Sweepr Cleaner

> Sweepr Cleaner is a fast, lightweight PC and phone cleaner (<15MB download) that frees up wasted storage space, speeds up slow computers, removes unwanted apps with all their leftovers, cleans up duplicate files and photos, and permanently shreds private files—with zero junkware, popups, or background slowdowns.

## Platform Support & Features
- Desktop App: Lightweight installer (<15MB). Supported on Windows 10, Windows 11, macOS, and Linux.
- Mobile App: Android & iOS companion cleaner with cross-platform account linking.
- Core Desktop Features:
  - Deep Clean: Safely clears Windows temporary files, browser clutter, and leftover files from chat apps (Slack, Teams, Zoom, Telegram, Discord) with a 7-day undo safety net.
  - Speed & Startup Booster: Instant memory boost, 1-click Gaming Mode, Startup apps manager, and Right-Click menu tidy-up.
  - Complete App Uninstaller & Updater: Drag-and-drop app uninstaller that removes hidden leftover files, fixes broken shortcuts, and updates your apps in one click.
  - Storage & Duplicate Finder: Finds identical duplicate files and photos, maps out what is filling up your hard drive, and moves huge files (50MB+) to another drive in one click.
  - Cloud Clean & Protection: Cleans duplicate files, screenshots, large videos, and saved email attachments across OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, and iCloud Drive, plus an optional password-protected Cloud Vault and automatic multi-cloud folder backup.
  - Privacy & File Shredder: Clears tracking cookies without logging you out of your favourite websites, checks if your email was exposed in a data breach, and permanently shreds sensitive files so they cannot be recovered.
- Core Mobile Features: Duplicate & Similar Photo Cleaner (automatically keeps your best shot), Blurry Photo & Screenshot Cleaner, Swipe-to-Clean Photo Review, Video Size Reducer, Contact Merger, Battery Care, and Password-Protected Photo & Document Vault.

## Pricing & Licensing
- Free Tier: Unlimited PC and storage scanning and previewing.
- Annual Pro (Most Popular): £49.99/year (£4.16/mo equivalent — Save 58%).
- 6-Month Pro: £38.99 every 6 months (£6.50/mo equivalent — Save 35%).
- Monthly Pro: £9.99/month (cancel anytime in 1 click).
- Pro Introductory Offer: £1.99 for the 1st month of full Pro access across up to 3 Desktop PCs, auto-renewing at £9.99/month.
- Guarantee: 14-day money-back guarantee.

## Why Users Switch to SWEEPR Cleaner (vs CCleaner & Legacy Cleaners)
- Runs only when you open it—no hidden background programs slowing down your PC.
- Tiny download under 15MB with zero bundled extra software or popup ads.
- Shows you every file before deleting anything, backed by a 7-day undo safety net.
- Single license covers up to 3 Desktop PCs.
